architecture: 208 raw public history features -> 96 SiLU -> 64 SiLU -> 8 utilities; 26792 parameters
inherited: Four cheap reports, one per group, available to every policy before additional spending
neural_stop: Stop when highest affordable predicted utility <= 0
pairing: Same world and action/visit noise tape across policies; drift changes bias after first paid cheap observation

primary.bootstrap: 2000 resamples of whole episode clusters, averaging model seeds within each episode

random: Uniform affordable paid actions until budget exhaustion
secondary: Report all six families and all baselines including no extra evidence, cheap only and reference only; analytic source-aware comparison is separate
selection: Minimum development decision regret; development masked MSE breaks ties; no test feedback
teacher: Exact one-step expected weighted accuracy gain minus observation price; explicit Bayesian predictor
truth_boundary: Synthetic finite worlds and programmed likelihoods; learned acquisition only; no AGI or biological/operational-domain claim
